<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="IEUCJ6CBqFHTVZJpmTTM"> <mxGraphModel dx="1873" dy="1022" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title System Layer Architecture

skinparam backgroundColor white
skinparam componentStyle rectangle
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName Arial

rectangle \"Presentation Layer\" as presentation {
 rectangle \"User Interface\" as ui
 rectangle \"API Gateway / Endpoints\" as api
}

rectangle \"Orchestration Layer\" as orchestration {
 rectangle \"LangGraph Orchestrator\" as orchestrator
 rectangle \"Task Planner / Decomposer\" as planner
}

rectangle \"Agent Layer\" as agents {
 rectangle \"Fact Verification Agent\" as fact
 rectangle \"Citation Verification Agent\" as citation
 rectangle \"Logic / Contradiction Agent\" as logic
 rectangle \"Reliability Evaluator\" as evaluator
 rectangle \"Self-Repair Agent\" as repair
 rectangle \"Response Generator\" as generator
}

rectangle \"Knowledge Layer\" as knowledge {
 rectangle \"RAG / Retrieval Engine\" as rag
 database \"Qdrant\nVector Database\" as qdrant
 database \"Neo4j\nKnowledge Graph\" as neo4j
}

rectangle \"Data Layer\" as data {
 database \"PostgreSQL\" as postgres
 rectangle \"Memory / Audit Logs\" as audit
}

ui --> api
api --> orchestrator
orchestrator --> planner
planner --> agents

fact --> rag
citation --> rag
logic --> rag

rag --> qdrant
rag --> neo4j

evaluator --> postgres
audit --> postgres

repair --> orchestrator
evaluator --> repair
evaluator --> generator

@enduml",
 "config": null
